name: SafeArea
purpose: Applies device safe-area insets (notch, home indicator) as padding on chosen edges.
scenarios: Keep a fixed bottom bar clear of the home indicator
Pad a full-screen layout so the notch never covers content
Inset only the block-end edge of a mobile page

top.description: Apply the top safe-area inset (status bar / notch).

bottom.description: Apply the bottom safe-area inset (home indicator / gesture bar).

states.name: default
states.description: Insets are applied according to the chosen edges.

antiPatterns: Do not nest multiple SafeArea components for the same edge.
Do not use SafeArea as a generic spacing utility; use Stack or space tokens.

keyboard: No interactive behavior; focus passes to children.
a11y.focus: Focus order is unchanged; the wrapper is a non-interactive region.
a11y.labeling: No accessible name; a presentational layout wrapper.

responsive.strategy: Insets resolve from env(safe-area-inset-*) with a 0px fallback; identical structure at every breakpoint, the values are device-driven rather than breakpoint-driven.

breakpoints.compact: env() insets apply on notched / gesture-navigation devices.
breakpoints.medium: Same as compact; insets are 0 where the device has no unsafe edges.
breakpoints.large: Typically resolves to 0 on desktop browsers (fallback path).

rtl.strategy: Logical padding only; start/end map to inline-start/inline-end and follow document direction.
